description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.2.5
更新内容
- 新增距离测量工具：在截图上标注距离，支持像素校准、单位、精度和端点样式设置。
- 截图保存更快捷：新增“另存为”和“快速保存”全局快捷键，可开启截图开始时的快门音；改善恢复上次选区后的确认和鼠标滚轮智能选择。
- 标注更顺手：文本可按可见范围自动换行，序号关联文字保留默认字号，框选也能选中点和水平、垂直线条。
- 贴图更稳定：改善多显示器上的贴图定位与窗口大小同步，贴图分组切换窗口采用原生窗口边框。
- macOS 原生通知：通过系统通知中心接收应用通知。
- 日常使用更可靠：减少 Windows 截图、录屏卡住的问题；打印预览失败时自动尝试传统打印对话框，改善旧版本覆盖安装后的更新功能。
What's new
- Distance measurement: annotate lengths on screenshots with pixel calibration, units, decimal precision, and endpoint styles.
- Faster saving: new global shortcuts for Save as file and Quick save, plus an optional shutter sound when capture starts. Restored selections and smart selection with the mouse wheel work more reliably.
- Easier annotation: text wraps within the visible area, numbered labels retain your default text size, and marquee selection includes dots and horizontal or vertical strokes.
- More stable pinned images: improved placement and size synchronization across monitors, with native window borders for the group switcher.
- Native macOS notifications: receive app notifications through Notification Center.
- Everyday reliability: fewer Windows capture and recording hangs; printing falls back to the classic dialog if modern preview fails. Upgrading an older installation also restores updater support.
Install on macOS / macOS 快速安装
Requires macOS 15 or later. Copy into Terminal and run as your usual user / 需要 macOS 15 或更新版本，以当前用户在终端执行：
Snow Shot
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.2.5_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh
Snow Shot Mini — Apple Silicon only / 仅支持 Apple Silicon
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.2.5_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition mini
The script selects your architecture, verifies the package, and installs into Applications. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions when prompted. / 脚本自动选择架构、校验安装包并安装到“应用程序”；按提示授予屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。
If GitHub is unavailable, replace https://github.com with https://gitee.com in either command. / 若 GitHub 下载不畅，将命令中的 https://github.com 替换为 https://gitee.com。
